_notes: Canonical sACN/E1.31 universe and channel assignments for all Gothic Folly LED zones.
All pixels are RGB (3 channels each). 510 channels max per universe.
Redesigned 2026-06-29: all zones now use contiguous per-port streams.
2026-07-12: major arches went full-resolution and moved to the tail (u39–u48); u3–u6 vacated. Interior orbs cut from the design entirely (u49 now free).
ROSE WINDOW — u1 (Rose Window A, petals 1–8) + u2 (Rose Window B, petals 9–16)
Each half: 8 petals × 14 cells × 3ch = 336ch, fits in one universe.
Ports 33–34 → u1; ports 35–36 → u2.
Note: these are the DESIGN-level (cell) universes; physical rose-window LEDs are
driven by an expanded FSEQ (see shows.md). xLights model split A/B pending — issue #21.
MAJOR ARCHES — u39–u48 (ports 29–32, SRx2 standalone) — FULL RESOLUTION (2026-07-12)
Each arch is every addressable WS2811 pixel (~216–233 px), not 20 grouped show-pixels.
Each arch gets its own 2-universe block: A u39–40, B u41–42, C u43–44, D u45–46, E u47–48.
Old u3–u6 are VACATED. Counts provisional pending crown-overshoot measurement.
MINOR ARCHES LEFT — u7–u11 (ports 21–24, SRx2 standalone)
Arch 1 (134px=402ch) and arch 5 (90px) share u7 (arch 5 starts at ch403, spans into u8).
Arches 2–4: u9, u10, u11.
MINOR ARCHES RIGHT — u12–u16 (ports 25–28, SRx2 standalone)
Same structure as left. Arch 1+5 share u12 (u13 overflow), arches 2–4: u14, u15, u16.
TOWER ZONES — u50–u75 (ports 5–20, chained SRs) — RELOCATED + CHAINED QUADS (2026-07-12, issue #76)
Was u17–u38. Each QUAD is now ONE chained data string on ONE SR output (Front→Left→Back→Right,
pixel 0 = front right foot), folded into the spire/canopy port streams. Streams flow across
universe boundaries (no null padding). Spire/spirelet/canopy at low ch, chained quad after.

towers.note: Per-port streams for all 4 towers: spires, spirelets, canopy, and CHAINED quad arches (each quad = one data string on one SR output — 2026-07-12 re-architecture, issue #76). Relocated u17–u38 → u50–u75 to fold the chained quads into the spire/canopy ports without colliding with the major arches (u39–u48). Multiple pixel types share each port stream; sim reads pixel positions from individual JSON files. Port→universe: FR p5=u50-52, p6=u53, p7=u54, p8=u55(canopy 8A/8B/8F + wash); FL p9=u56-58, p10=u59, p11=u60(spirelets + canopy 11A/11B), p12=u61(spirelets + canopy 12F + wash); BL p13=u62-64, p14=u65, p15=u66, p16=u67(wash 16A ch1-12 #102 + quad, canopy moved front #95); BR p17=u69-71, p18=u72, p19=u73, p20=u74(wash 20A ch1-12 #102 + quad, canopy moved front #95). Canopy is FED FROM THE FRONT TOWERS (#95): FR runs on p8, FL runs on p11/p12; upper 44px on the spire SRx4, lower 38px on the low SRx2. Chained quads: FTR 5E=u50ch157, FTL 9E=u56ch157, BBL 13E=u62ch157, BBR 17E=u69ch157, BTL 16D=u67ch379, BTR 20D=u74ch379.
